action_items: REACT ANTIPATTERN (non-blocking but real): In /app/frontend/src/pages/Auth.js the component `CaptchaField` is defined INSIDE the Auth component body (line ~116). Every parent state change (each keystroke on any field) creates a new component identity, causing React to unmount+remount the CaptchaField subtree (including its <Input>). This causes focus loss on the captcha input as users type and can lead to intermittent typing/UX issues. Fix: hoist CaptchaField outside the Auth component and pass captcha, captchaAns, setCaptchaAns, refreshCaptcha as props (or inline the JSX instead of wrapping in a component).
critical_code_review_comments: Auth.js: inline `const CaptchaField = () => (...)` inside Auth() is a React antipattern (see action item). Same pattern would apply to any inline components in this file.
